due_when.clears_when: A build lane ships a fix (archive-fallback in the drift endpoint/gate, a shorter reference window that fits inside one rotation cycle, or a lengthened rotation cadence) AND a subsequent drift read taken shortly after a rotation returns a populated reference_count instead of insufficient_data.

origin.rerun: vm-diag-request: api/bot/shadow/drift?model_id=<any advisory or shadow model id> -- if reference_count=0 while log_coverage.oldest_retained is within the last ~30 days of a rotation, the finding still holds. Cross-check with trainer-vm-diag: ls -la runtime_logs/shadow_predictions*.jsonl* to date the most recent rotation, and ml gate-check <model_id> --db data/trade_journal.db --datasets-root datasets-out to check whether drift_clean/live_regime_discrimination read insufficient_data rather than a computed value.

what: The drift_clean and live_regime_discrimination gates in ml gate-check, and the /api/bot/shadow/drift endpoint, read ONLY the ACTIVE runtime_logs/shadow_predictions.jsonl and never fall back to the rotated .jsonl.gz archives sitting beside it. ict-shadow-log-rotate.timer is enabled and healthy (MEASURED vm-diag-snapshot #13063: services path, ict-shadow-log-rotate.timer active, .service inactive as expected for an idle oneshot) and rotates on a SIZE trigger observed firing at 2026-07-07, 2026-08-05, 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-26 (MEASURED trainer-vm-diag #13062:  on the trainer) -- a ~25-29 day cadence. The drift endpoint defaults to reference_days=30 + current_days=7 (~37 days total lookback), which is LONGER than the observed rotation cadence, so the reference window can never be fully populated before the next rotation empties the active log. MEASURED this session (ml-review W6-M1, comms/reviews/ml-review-20260927-063330.json): immediately post-rotation (2026-09-27, ~24h after the 09-26T06:39:57Z rotation), api/bot/shadow/drift returns reference_count=0 / verdict=insufficient_data for ALL THREE models checked (btc-regime-15m-lgbm-fc-pcv-v2, sol-regime-15m-lgbm-fc-pcv-v2, mes-regime-5m-lgbm-v2-- vm-diag-snapshot #13051), and ml gate-check's drift_clean + live_regime_discrimination gates read insufficient_data for all three (trainer-vm-diag #13053/#13060/#13061), where the SAME gates read computed KS/PSI/AUC verdicts (some "significant", some "pass") in the 2026-09-24 (E72) and 2026-09-25 (W4 re-verify / PR #12960) reviews on the pre-rotation log. INFERRED: no drift verdict this repo has ever fed into a Tier-3 promotion/demotion decision -- including E72's "significant" KS readings that seeded the original btc/sol demote proposals -- was ever computed on the endpoint's own intended full 30-day reference window, because the log had never gone 30 days without a rotation event landing inside that window; and for roughly the first 1-2 weeks after every rotation the instrument is fully blind (reference_count=0) rather than merely thin. Not yet established: whether reference_count partially recovers before the NEXT rotation hits (~25-29 days), i.e. whether the reference window is ever more than ~60% populated at best.
